_about: Listing sites per city, tested 30 Sep 2026 by fetching them as plain HTML (no browser). 'works' = returned readable event data; 'partial' = some data, missing prices or later dates; 'blocked' = JS-only, 403 or robots-blocked. Use 'works' sources first when refreshing data/<city>.json.

works.name: Songkick metro pages
works.note: Dates, artists, venues. No prices. Good for concerts and big DJ shows.

works.name: Bandsintown city pages
works.note: Dates and artists, weak on club nights.

works.name: Shotgun city/genre pages
works.note: Dates + prices. Good for Paris, Lisbon, New York. Only shows the first ~5 days.

works.name: Shotgun venue pages
works.note: Full venue program with prices (e.g. rex-club).

works.name: Mood (musicofourdesire)
works.note: Mirrors RA events with readable dates and lineups.

blocked.name: Resident Advisor (ra.co)
blocked.note: JS-rendered, returns only navigation. Use RA event URLs as ticket links, but read data elsewhere.

blocked.name: GoOut ticket pages
blocked.note: Prices load with JS. GoOut event pages (goout.net/{lang}/{slug}/{id}/) DO show price ranges.

works.name: GoOut event pages
works.note: Date, time, price range in CZK.

works.name: Cross Club program
works.note: Full lineups, links to GoOut.

works.name: Ankali upcoming
